name: Stadiongaststätte
kurzbeschreibung:
**Local pub with stadium views in Pfronten**

Enjoy a relaxed atmosphere in our cozy **Stadiongaststätte** with panoramic views of the **Allgäu Arena** in Pfronten. Whether you're a football fan or just looking for a great spot to unwind, our rustic tavern offers hearty **Tiroler** dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, fresh **Obazda**, and crisp **Radler**—all paired with a warm, alpine vibe.

Perfect for pre- or post-match gatherings, family meals, or a quiet drink with friends. Come by and soak up the mountain air while cheering on your team!
